pages.title: Food Tooltips
pages.text: Hover over any food item to see which food group it belongs to and how much nutrition it provides.

pages.title: Reading Tooltips
pages.text: The tooltip shows the food's $(bold)group$(), its $(bold)nutrition value$(), and its $(bold)family$(). Foods from the same family give diminishing returns — variety within a group matters as much as the group itself.
